description: Special roster, official-English win quotes beyond the 17-character roster: the bosses Apocalypse (slot 0) and Mech-Gouki (slot 19, SPECIAL-004, user request 2026-10-26); Norimaro (slot 17, SPECIAL-002, user request 2026-10-26) and the secret characters with their own US arcade English, slots 22-24 (SPECIAL-003). Slots 20-21 get new translations (data/translations); slot 25 shares Spider-Man's block.
decision: SPECIAL-002/SPECIAL-003 (user, 2026-10-26): official English where it exists; new translations where the official English is only a substitute.
verification: EXP-0078 (slots 22-24) and EXP-0079 (slot 17): tools/reference/roster_pairing on mshvsfu, mshvsf, mshvsfj: each table byte-identical to its arcade Japanese slot; English identical across the three sets and present on the PS1 (SELECT.BIN 0x12E0C, 0x13DAC, 0x140CC, 0x143EC). SPECIAL-004: slots 0 (MC00 0x3174) and 19 (MC13 0xA06C) the same way: tables byte-identical to arcade Japanese slots 0 and 19 in all three sets, English identical across sets, on the PS1 (SELECT.BIN 0x0F8EC, 0x1344C), no placeholders.
